description: Πινακίδες ΕΥΔΑΠ κατασκευασμένου δικτύου ομβρίων υδάτων is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Περιφέρεια Αττικής. Uz Atikas reģiona ceļiem izbūvētā lietusūdens tīkla horizontālā kartēšana mērogā 1:5000, ko EYDAP atjaunināja līdz 2000. gadam. Coverage: Περιφέρεια Αττικής. The portal shows the English title as "EYDAP-Zeichen eines gebauten Regenwassernetzes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Περιφέρεια Αττικής. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 1 download or service links in DWG. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
